hero.description: With +{{experience}} years of experience, I transform digital ideas into intuitive, accessible, and impactful user interfaces. Specialist in Scss and Figma.

about.heading: About me
about.p1: I am a Semi-Senior Frontend Developer experienced in creating user interfaces for all kinds of websites. Passionate about UX Writing and pursuing <1>equitability</1> through efficient code, aiming to deliver highly accessible and intuitive digital products.
about.p2: My career has mostly developed working on B2B E-Commerce projects, both as a freelancer and as an employee for a company. I enjoy working in teams and iterating together to achieve the best possible solution. I believe diversity is the key point in creating equitable and functional digital solutions.
about.p3: Understanding the global context and prioritizing responsive design, I constantly seek to optimize user experience through clear copy, web performance, and accessibility. My goal is to build applications that not only look good but are also comfortable to use.
